name: Terrain Assessment: Terrain Assessment Test Profile (1 Candidates)

profile_snapshot.name: Terrain Assessment Test Profile
profile_snapshot.description: Profile used for terrain suitability engine testing.

min_total_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Sunlight Duration
min_total_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of geometric illumination across the user-configured mission analysis window.
min_total_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric illumination accounts for terrain line-of-sight and finite-disk clearance; it does not model photovoltaic panel angle of incidence or electrical power generation.

min_full_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Full Sunlight Duration
min_full_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration where the solar disk is 100% unoccluded by terrain. Full sunlight is a geometric subset of total sunlight.
min_full_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Requires 100% solar disk clearance above local horizon.

max_continuous_darkness_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Darkness Duration
max_continuous_darkness_hours.description: Maximum uninterrupted duration of darkness (battery energy storage limit).
max_continuous_darkness_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Evaluates uninterrupted periods where solar disk visible fraction is zero.

min_sunlight_percentage.name: Minimum Sunlight Percentage
min_sunlight_percentage.description: Ratio of total illuminated hours to total mission duration (expressed in %).
min_sunlight_percentage.scientific_disclaimer: Denominator is the total user-configured mission duration.

min_daily_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Daily Sunlight Duration
min_daily_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum geometric illumination required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative hours with solar disk clearance f_disk > 0 in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth operational day. Partial illumination (f_disk > 0) contributes to geometric duration; does not evaluate solar incident cosine angle or battery charge efficiency.

min_total_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Earth Visibility
min_total_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of direct geometric line-of-sight to Earth across the mission analysis window.
min_total_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric Earth visibility does not guarantee an operational radio link; RF link budget, antenna pointing, and data rates are not modeled.

max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Earth LOS Blackout
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.description: Maximum allowable duration of continuous Direct-to-Earth loss of signal (LOS).
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Periods where Earth disk is completely obstructed by local terrain.

min_daily_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Daily Earth Visibility
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum Direct-to-Earth line-of-sight required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative visible contact hours in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth day. Line-of-sight clearance does not evaluate RF link budget or ground station scheduling.

min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Full-Disk Earth Visibility
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.description: Cumulative duration where the entire Earth disk is completely unoccluded by terrain. Full-disk visibility is a geometric subset of total visibility.
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Full-disk clearance without partial atmospheric limb clipping.

max_local_slope_deg.name: Maximum Allowable Landing Site Slope
max_local_slope_deg.description: Maximum local slope at landing site.

scenario_snapshots.name: Connecting Ridge — High Crest (Peak Beta)
scenario_snapshots.description: High-elevation crest on the Shackleton-de Gerlache Connecting Ridge with prolonged solar illumination and direct Earth line-of-sight.

dataset_metadata.name: Site 01 (Connecting Ridge)
dataset_metadata.region_name: Lunar South Pole / Shackleton-de Gerlache Connecting Ridge
dataset_metadata.projection_crs: South Polar Stereographic (Lat_0=-90, Lon_0=0, R=1,737,400 m)
dataset_metadata.publication_ref: Barker et al. (2021), Planetary and Space Science, 203, 105119
dataset_metadata.effective_resolution_note: 5 m/pixel grid spacing. ~90% of pixels in LOLA polar grids are interpolated between tracks. Refer to the LDEC product for laser return counts.

calculation_method: LUNAVISTA Terrain Suitability Engine v1.0 (NASA LOLA 5m/px)

elevation_metrics.datum_note: Elevation is measured relative to the lunar reference sphere (1737.4 km), not spacecraft altitude above ground.

slope_metrics.slope_source: NASA LOLA 5 m/pixel co-registered slope product (Site01_final_adj_5mpp_slp.tif)

roughness_metrics.scientific_justification: Official LOLA terrain roughness product is not loaded in repository data directory. In accordance with lunar landing site evaluation guidelines, slope or elevation variance cannot be substituted for micro-relief roughness or boulder hazard detection.

data_quality.effective_resolution_note: Nominal 5 m/pixel grid spacing. ~90% of LOLA polar pixels are interpolated between ground tracks. Grid spacing does not guarantee effective measurement resolution.

hard_constraint_results.explanation: Measured slope satisfies requirement across complete footprint (Point: 3.7° (Footprint Max: 11.9°) vs threshold le 15.0 deg).
Surface elevation satisfies minimum limit (+1944.6 m (Min: +1939.1 m) vs threshold ge -500.0 m).
Terrain roughness product is not loaded; metric cannot be verified without substituting slope.

soft_preference_results.explanation: Surface elevation satisfies upper limit (+1944.6 m (Max: +1947.8 m) vs threshold le 2500.0 m).

scientific_disclaimers: Candidate does not satisfy configured terrain requirements (or data coverage is indeterminate).
This assessment does not declare the site safe to land on.
Elevation measurements are referenced to the IAU Moon 2000 Reference Sphere (R = 1,737,400.0 m) and do not represent spacecraft altitude above ground.
Surface slope alone does not guarantee lunar landing safety, regolith trafficability, or rover navigability.
Terrain roughness is not a substitute for boulder detection. Small-scale meter-level boulder hazards are below LOLA 5 m/pixel raster resolution.
A digital elevation model does not establish subsurface bearing capacity, soil cohesion, or geotechnical mechanical properties.
A 5 m nominal grid spacing does not guarantee 5 m effective measurement resolution (~90% of polar pixels are interpolated between ground tracks).
A point measurement does not certify the suitability of an entire landing footprint.
Partial DEM coverage cannot certify the missing terrain.

name: Terrain Assessment: Terrain Assessment Test Profile (1 Candidates)

profile_snapshot.name: Terrain Assessment Test Profile
profile_snapshot.description: Profile used for terrain suitability engine testing.

min_total_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Sunlight Duration
min_total_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of geometric illumination across the user-configured mission analysis window.
min_total_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric illumination accounts for terrain line-of-sight and finite-disk clearance; it does not model photovoltaic panel angle of incidence or electrical power generation.

min_full_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Full Sunlight Duration
min_full_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration where the solar disk is 100% unoccluded by terrain. Full sunlight is a geometric subset of total sunlight.
min_full_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Requires 100% solar disk clearance above local horizon.

max_continuous_darkness_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Darkness Duration
max_continuous_darkness_hours.description: Maximum uninterrupted duration of darkness (battery energy storage limit).
max_continuous_darkness_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Evaluates uninterrupted periods where solar disk visible fraction is zero.

min_sunlight_percentage.name: Minimum Sunlight Percentage
min_sunlight_percentage.description: Ratio of total illuminated hours to total mission duration (expressed in %).
min_sunlight_percentage.scientific_disclaimer: Denominator is the total user-configured mission duration.

min_daily_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Daily Sunlight Duration
min_daily_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum geometric illumination required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative hours with solar disk clearance f_disk > 0 in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth operational day. Partial illumination (f_disk > 0) contributes to geometric duration; does not evaluate solar incident cosine angle or battery charge efficiency.

min_total_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Earth Visibility
min_total_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of direct geometric line-of-sight to Earth across the mission analysis window.
min_total_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric Earth visibility does not guarantee an operational radio link; RF link budget, antenna pointing, and data rates are not modeled.

max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Earth LOS Blackout
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.description: Maximum allowable duration of continuous Direct-to-Earth loss of signal (LOS).
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Periods where Earth disk is completely obstructed by local terrain.

min_daily_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Daily Earth Visibility
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum Direct-to-Earth line-of-sight required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative visible contact hours in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth day. Line-of-sight clearance does not evaluate RF link budget or ground station scheduling.

min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Full-Disk Earth Visibility
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.description: Cumulative duration where the entire Earth disk is completely unoccluded by terrain. Full-disk visibility is a geometric subset of total visibility.
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Full-disk clearance without partial atmospheric limb clipping.

min_sunlight_percentage.name: Minimum Sunlight Percentage

min_daily_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Daily Sunlight Duration
min_daily_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum geometric illumination required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative hours with solar disk clearance f_disk > 0 in each standard 24h operational window.

min_total_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Earth Visibility

max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Earth LOS Blackout

min_daily_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Daily Earth Visibility

min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Full-Disk Earth Visibility

min_total_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Sunlight Duration

min_full_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Full Sunlight Duration

max_continuous_darkness_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Darkness Duration
max_continuous_darkness_hours.description: Maximum uninterrupted duration of darkness (battery energy storage limit).
max_continuous_darkness_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Evaluates uninterrupted periods where solar disk visible fraction is zero.

min_sunlight_percentage.name: Minimum Sunlight Percentage
min_sunlight_percentage.description: Ratio of total illuminated hours to total mission duration (expressed in %).
min_sunlight_percentage.scientific_disclaimer: Denominator is the total user-configured mission duration.

min_daily_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Daily Sunlight Duration

min_total_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Earth Visibility

min_daily_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Daily Earth Visibility

min_full_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Full Sunlight Duration

profile_snapshot.description: Profile used for terrain suitability engine testing.

min_total_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Sunlight Duration
min_total_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of geometric illumination across the user-configured mission analysis window.
min_total_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric illumination accounts for terrain line-of-sight and finite-disk clearance; it does not model photovoltaic panel angle of incidence or electrical power generation.

min_full_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Full Sunlight Duration
min_full_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration where the solar disk is 100% unoccluded by terrain. Full sunlight is a geometric subset of total sunlight.
min_full_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Requires 100% solar disk clearance above local horizon.

max_continuous_darkness_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Darkness Duration
max_continuous_darkness_hours.description: Maximum uninterrupted duration of darkness (battery energy storage limit).
max_continuous_darkness_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Evaluates uninterrupted periods where solar disk visible fraction is zero.

min_sunlight_percentage.name: Minimum Sunlight Percentage
min_sunlight_percentage.description: Ratio of total illuminated hours to total mission duration (expressed in %).
min_sunlight_percentage.scientific_disclaimer: Denominator is the total user-configured mission duration.

min_daily_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Daily Sunlight Duration
min_daily_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum geometric illumination required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative hours with solar disk clearance f_disk > 0 in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth operational day. Partial illumination (f_disk > 0) contributes to geometric duration; does not evaluate solar incident cosine angle or battery charge efficiency.

min_total_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Earth Visibility
min_total_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of direct geometric line-of-sight to Earth across the mission analysis window.
min_total_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric Earth visibility does not guarantee an operational radio link; RF link budget, antenna pointing, and data rates are not modeled.

max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Earth LOS Blackout
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.description: Maximum allowable duration of continuous Direct-to-Earth loss of signal (LOS).
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Periods where Earth disk is completely obstructed by local terrain.

min_daily_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Daily Earth Visibility
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum Direct-to-Earth line-of-sight required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative visible contact hours in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth day. Line-of-sight clearance does not evaluate RF link budget or ground station scheduling.

min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Full-Disk Earth Visibility
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.description: Cumulative duration where the entire Earth disk is completely unoccluded by terrain. Full-disk visibility is a geometric subset of total visibility.
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Full-disk clearance without partial atmospheric limb clipping.

max_local_slope_deg.name: Maximum Allowable Landing Site Slope
max_local_slope_deg.description: Maximum local slope at landing site.

dataset_metadata.name: Site 01 (Connecting Ridge)
dataset_metadata.region_name: Lunar South Pole / Shackleton-de Gerlache Connecting Ridge
dataset_metadata.projection_crs: South Polar Stereographic (Lat_0=-90, Lon_0=0, R=1,737,400 m)
dataset_metadata.publication_ref: Barker et al. (2021), Planetary and Space Science, 203, 105119
dataset_metadata.effective_resolution_note: 5 m/pixel grid spacing. ~90% of pixels in LOLA polar grids are interpolated between tracks. Refer to the LDEC product for laser return counts.

calculation_method: LUNAVISTA Terrain Suitability Engine v1.0 (NASA LOLA 5m/px)

elevation_metrics.datum_note: Elevation is measured relative to the lunar reference sphere (1737.4 km), not spacecraft altitude above ground.

slope_metrics.slope_source: NASA LOLA 5 m/pixel co-registered slope product (Site01_final_adj_5mpp_slp.tif)

roughness_metrics.scientific_justification: Official LOLA terrain roughness product is not loaded in repository data directory. In accordance with lunar landing site evaluation guidelines, slope or elevation variance cannot be substituted for micro-relief roughness or boulder hazard detection.

data_quality.effective_resolution_note: Nominal 5 m/pixel grid spacing. Effective spatial resolution varies with LOLA orbital track density; pixels between laser ground tracks are interpolated. Nominal grid spacing does not guarantee 5 m effective measurement resolution.

hard_constraint_results.explanation: Measured slope satisfies requirement across complete 100% evaluated footprint (Point: 3.7° | Footprint Max: 11.9° | Exceedance: 0.0% vs threshold le 15.0 deg).
Surface elevation satisfies minimum limit across complete 100% evaluated footprint (Point: +1944.6 m | Footprint Min: +1939.1 m vs threshold ge -500.0 m).
Terrain roughness product is not loaded; metric cannot be verified without substituting slope.

soft_preference_results.explanation: Surface elevation satisfies upper limit across complete 100% evaluated footprint (Point: +1944.6 m | Footprint Max: +1947.8 m vs threshold le 2500.0 m).

scientific_disclaimers: Candidate does not satisfy configured terrain requirements (or data coverage is indeterminate).
This assessment does not declare the site safe to land on.
Elevation measurements are referenced to the IAU Moon 2000 Reference Sphere (R = 1,737,400.0 m) and do not represent spacecraft altitude above ground.
Surface slope alone does not guarantee lunar landing safety, regolith trafficability, or rover navigability.
Terrain roughness is not a substitute for boulder detection. Small-scale meter-level boulder hazards are below LOLA 5 m/pixel raster resolution.
A digital elevation model does not establish subsurface bearing capacity, soil cohesion, or geotechnical mechanical properties.
A 5 m nominal grid spacing does not guarantee 5 m effective measurement resolution (raster values between LOLA ground tracks are interpolated).
A point measurement does not certify the suitability of an entire landing footprint.
Partial DEM coverage cannot certify the missing terrain.

profile_snapshot.description: Profile to verify non-overlapping coverage boundaries and certification rules

min_total_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Sunlight Duration
min_total_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of geometric illumination across the user-configured mission analysis window.
min_total_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric illumination accounts for terrain line-of-sight and finite-disk clearance; it does not model photovoltaic panel angle of incidence or electrical power generation.

min_full_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Full Sunlight Duration
min_full_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration where the solar disk is 100% unoccluded by terrain. Full sunlight is a geometric subset of total sunlight.
min_full_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Requires 100% solar disk clearance above local horizon.

max_continuous_darkness_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Darkness Duration
max_continuous_darkness_hours.description: Maximum uninterrupted duration of darkness (battery energy storage limit).
max_continuous_darkness_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Evaluates uninterrupted periods where solar disk visible fraction is zero.

min_sunlight_percentage.name: Minimum Sunlight Percentage
min_sunlight_percentage.description: Ratio of total illuminated hours to total mission duration (expressed in %).
min_sunlight_percentage.scientific_disclaimer: Denominator is the total user-configured mission duration.

min_daily_sunlight_hours.name: Minimum Daily Sunlight Duration
min_daily_sunlight_hours.description: Minimum geometric illumination required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative hours with solar disk clearance f_disk > 0 in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_sunlight_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth operational day. Partial illumination (f_disk > 0) contributes to geometric duration; does not evaluate solar incident cosine angle or battery charge efficiency.

min_total_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Total Geometric Earth Visibility
min_total_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum cumulative duration of direct geometric line-of-sight to Earth across the mission analysis window.
min_total_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Geometric Earth visibility does not guarantee an operational radio link; RF link budget, antenna pointing, and data rates are not modeled.

max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.name: Maximum Continuous Earth LOS Blackout
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.description: Maximum allowable duration of continuous Direct-to-Earth loss of signal (LOS).
max_continuous_earth_blackout_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Periods where Earth disk is completely obstructed by local terrain.

min_daily_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Daily Earth Visibility
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.description: Minimum Direct-to-Earth line-of-sight required per standard 24.0-hour Earth day interval (distinct from the ~708.7 h lunar synodic day). Evaluates cumulative visible contact hours in each standard 24h operational window.
min_daily_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Applies per standard 24.0-hour Earth day. Line-of-sight clearance does not evaluate RF link budget or ground station scheduling.

min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.name: Minimum Full-Disk Earth Visibility
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.description: Cumulative duration where the entire Earth disk is completely unoccluded by terrain. Full-disk visibility is a geometric subset of total visibility.
min_full_disk_earth_visible_hours.scientific_disclaimer: Full-disk clearance without partial atmospheric limb clipping.

max_local_slope_deg.name: Maximum Allowable Landing Site Slope
max_local_slope_deg.description: Maximum local slope at the landing/observation site (lander tip-over safety threshold).
max_local_slope_deg.scientific_disclaimer: Derived from NASA LOLA 5 m DEM slope maps. Geomorphic slope alone does not guarantee boulder clearance or regolith trafficability.

min_elevation_m.name: Minimum Surface Elevation
min_elevation_m.description: Minimum surface elevation above the IAU 1,737,400 m lunar sphere datum.
min_elevation_m.scientific_disclaimer: Reference datum is the IAU Moon 2000 Sphere (R = 1,737,400.0 m).

max_elevation_m.name: Maximum Surface Elevation
max_elevation_m.description: Maximum surface elevation above the IAU 1,737,400 m lunar sphere datum.
max_elevation_m.scientific_disclaimer: Reference datum is the IAU Moon 2000 Sphere (R = 1,737,400.0 m).

max_roughness_factor.name: Maximum Local Terrain Roughness Factor
max_roughness_factor.description: Local standard deviation of slope within the landing area footprint.
max_roughness_factor.scientific_disclaimer: Derived from local 5 m DEM neighborhood variance.

dataset_metadata.name: Site 01 (Connecting Ridge)
dataset_metadata.region_name: Lunar South Pole / Shackleton-de Gerlache Connecting Ridge
dataset_metadata.projection_crs: South Polar Stereographic (Lat_0=-90, Lon_0=0, R=1,737,400 m)
dataset_metadata.publication_ref: Barker et al. (2021), Planetary and Space Science, 203, 105119
dataset_metadata.effective_resolution_note: 5 m/pixel grid spacing. ~90% of pixels in LOLA polar grids are interpolated between tracks. Refer to the LDEC product for laser return counts.

calculation_method: LUNAVISTA Terrain Suitability Engine v1.0 (NASA LOLA 5m/px)

elevation_metrics.datum_note: Elevation is measured relative to the lunar reference sphere (1737.4 km), not spacecraft altitude above ground.

slope_metrics.slope_source: NASA LOLA 5 m/pixel co-registered slope product (Site01_final_adj_5mpp_slp.tif)

roughness_metrics.scientific_justification: Official LOLA terrain roughness product is not loaded in repository data directory. In accordance with lunar landing site evaluation guidelines, slope or elevation variance cannot be substituted for micro-relief roughness or boulder hazard detection.

data_quality.effective_resolution_note: Nominal 5 m/pixel grid spacing. Effective spatial resolution varies with LOLA orbital track density; pixels between laser ground tracks are interpolated. Nominal grid spacing does not guarantee 5 m effective measurement resolution.

hard_constraint_results.explanation: Candidate point slope satisfies requirement (Point: 3.7° vs threshold le 10.0 deg).

scientific_disclaimers: Meets configured terrain requirements within evaluated data coverage.
This assessment does not declare the site safe to land on.
Elevation measurements are referenced to the IAU Moon 2000 Reference Sphere (R = 1,737,400.0 m) and do not represent spacecraft altitude above ground.
Surface slope alone does not guarantee lunar landing safety, regolith trafficability, or rover navigability.
Terrain roughness is not a substitute for boulder detection. Small-scale meter-level boulder hazards are below LOLA 5 m/pixel raster resolution.
A digital elevation model does not establish subsurface bearing capacity, soil cohesion, or geotechnical mechanical properties.
A 5 m nominal grid spacing does not guarantee 5 m effective measurement resolution (raster values between LOLA ground tracks are interpolated).
A point measurement does not certify the suitability of an entire landing footprint.
Partial DEM coverage cannot certify the missing terrain.
